meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以给幻灯片、文档、报告、HTML 页面等作品套用预设的 10 套配色和字体主题，也能根据你的描述现场生成新主题并应用。
howto.when: 当你要求美化或统一某个作品（如幻灯片、文档）的样式时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这份幻灯片套用「Ocean Depths」主题。
say.note: Claude 会读取主题文件并应用配色和字体。

say.text: 生成一个以星空为主题的新配色方案。
say.note: Claude 会创建新主题并让你确认后应用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can apply one of 10 preset color and font themes to artifacts like slides, docs, reports, or HTML pages, or generate a custom theme on the fly based on your description.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to style or unify the appearance of an artifact such as a slide deck or document.

say_en.text: Apply the 'Ocean Depths' theme to this slide deck.
say_en.note: Claude reads the theme file and applies colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Create a new theme inspired by a starry sky.
say_en.note: Claude generates a custom theme and asks for confirmation before applying.
